key.name: margin-x
key.summary: Distance of the outer islands from the screen sides in px

key.name: margin-top
key.summary: Distance of the islands from the top edge in px

key.name: island-padding
key.summary: Horizontal padding inside each island in px

key.name: autohide
key.summary: Slide the bar out of view and reveal it from the top edge

key.name: intellihide
key.summary: With autohide on, only hide while a window overlaps the bar

key.name: hide-clock
key.summary: Hide the middle island (clock and notifications menu) while no window is open, i.e. on the desktop
